content: Web terminal sharing landscape 2026: ttyd (C/libwebsockets 1.7.7), gotty (Go, archived), wetty (Node.js, needs runtime), sshx (Rust+gRPC central-server multiplayer), upterm (Go, SSH-based), tmate (C tmux fork). No dominant actively-maintained single-static-binary successor; the niche wesh targets is open. Both Go (gotty/upterm) and Rust (sshx) have proven precedents.
